release_intent: One-way server learning; independent personal flies; fair forward evaluation
data_flow: An explicit enrollment signs consent and fixes next period's full local checkpoint hash and private teaching-head version.
A browser-local copy runs the actual WASM brain with plasticity frozen. Each task starts from that copy; personal storage is not written.
The server applies the frozen private teaching head to the signed neural decoder, then runs a separate standardized spot account.
The official server policy learns only from consented predictions in completed periods. No model weights are distributed to personal flies.

evaluation.default_period: Daily 00:00 to 00:00 UTC; persisted rules version per period
evaluation.enrollment: Next period only. A new consent/enrollment is required per period. No automatic migration of legacy colony consent.
evaluation.starting_assets: BTC worth USD 10000 at the common period opening price; no initial purchase fee because the initial holding is granted equally
evaluation.decisions: Every 300 seconds, 120 seconds to submit; execute at the open of the minute beginning 60 seconds after the deadline, once that bar closes
evaluation.positions: BTC or USD cash, no leverage or shorts, full spot allocation
evaluation.ranking: Net mark-to-market return after costs. Full global schedule and all personal predictions required. Ties share rank; percentile counts strictly lower returns.
evaluation.risk: Maximum drawdown sampled at minute marks and executions. This does not measure intraminute extremes.
benchmarks: Official fly, frozen server policy version for the period
evaluation.funds: Dedicated universe_entries state. Never reads personal cash for evaluation or writes portfolios/shop inventory.

learning.model: Bounded 3-action softmax decision model with 7 market/portfolio features; distinct from the full local connectome
learning.labels: Compare each actual received action against waiting at the next task execution mark, including paid costs. Positive advantage teaches the executed action; otherwise teaches HOLD. The last task has no next-period label and is excluded.
learning.weighting: One total training weight per task, divided over distinct checkpoint+teaching-head clusters, then over owners within each cluster
learning.jobs: Resumable per-finished-period training, four task groups per cron invocation. Immutable version published after the entire period is consumed. Only subsequent periods can use it.
learning.cold_start: Version 0 holds the initial BTC. UI states collecting experience; no invented performance or superiority claim.
learning.limitations: Outcome-conditioned distillation is a first server learner, not proof of generalization or trading advantage. No hyperparameter search on evaluation periods.

trust_and_operations.execution_trust: Owner-signed browser report; signature validates identity and task binding, not independent neural execution attestation
trust_and_operations.identity: One fly per account per period. This is not a Sybil-resistant identity system. No money prizes.
trust_and_operations.scheduler: Existing minute cron, 180-second dispatcher lease, immutable per-entry event receipts and revision guards; bound JSON settlement chunks of 256 entries, up to four chunks per task. Enrollment capped atomically at 1000 personal flies per period.
trust_and_operations.failure_policy: No retroactive submissions. Missing execution bars or global slots prevent complete-period rank/training. Missing personal decisions remain explicit and exclude that fly from final rank.
trust_and_operations.browser: Visible browser required. The shared WASM runtime pauses personal automatic trading while evaluating. Archived local copies are pruned; current and next-period copies remain.
trust_and_operations.migration: 0016_universe.sql is additive and must run before the new Worker cron. It must not be replaced by replaying historical migrations.
trust_and_operations.legacy: Existing group voting remains under a collapsed experiment. Cross-router replication and model distribution are not active.
trust_and_operations.capacity: The initial 1000-entry period limit bounds per-tick work. Operators must size their D1 plan for minute marks and durable decision history before attracting this load.

ui: More > Fly universe; official policy and benchmarks, period selector, personal leaderboard, explicit opt-in, detailed rules. Responsive Chinese/English, day/night. Home has no additional status.
